description: Phase-DOCSKL — restore document generation + add skill management tool. 2 atomic stories ~+250 LOC. userStories.description: Wire the existing-but-dormant CreatePDFTool/CreateXLSXTool/CreateDOCXTool builders into a single LLM-callable `create_document` action-enum tool (Aura convention per task/source/wiki_page). The library + builders + tests are already in master at internal/files/{pdf,docx,xlsx}.go + internal/agent/tools/registry/files_{pdf,xlsx,docx}.go. Phase-TOOL deleted them from the LLM manifest during the kill-the-rag wave but the Go code stayed dormant. Re-expose under ONE consolidated tool name with action enum to keep the manifest lean: `create_document(format='pdf'|'xlsx'|'docx', spec={…block-grammar…})`. Per format, dispatch to the existing builder's Execute. Same block grammar across all 3 formats (already consistent in files_{pdf,docx,xlsx}.go — confirmed via doc comment 'Same block grammar as create_docx so the LLM only has to learn one DSL'). Add deny-by-default to AURA_TOOL_ALLOWLIST → opt-in via `create_document` token. CRITICAL: do NOT add 3 separate tools (create_pdf, create_xlsx, create_docx) — that violates Aura's action-enum convention + bloats manifest. The single-tool dispatch is the contract. Deep refactor on touch: if files_pdf.go / files_xlsx.go / files_docx.go have any leftover dead code (e.g., a removed-but-not-cleaned helper from the kill-the-rag pass), delete in same commit. Live-test discipline: container rebuild + probe_chat with 3 prompts (one per format) + bytes-of-artifact verification (unzip xlsx to read sharedStrings, parse pdf via pdftotext or `internal/files/pdf.go` reverse, parse docx word/document.xml).

userStories.title: New skill(action=list|catalog|install|info|remove) tool — kill 'non ho install_skill' admission
userStories.description: Brand-new LLM-callable tool wrapping the existing /api/skills/catalog + /api/skills/install + /api/skills handlers. Pattern: action-enum (Aura convention; matches hermes-agent skill_manage). Actions: `list` (current installed: wraps GET /skills); `catalog` (browse skills.sh registry: wraps GET /skills/catalog); `install` (install from skills.sh by source+skill_id: wraps POST /skills/install); `info` (read SKILL.md of installed skill); `remove` (uninstall: wraps DELETE /skills/{name}). The install action is admin-gated (SKILLS_ADMIN capability). Make the gate VISIBLE to the LLM via denial schema (returns {error: 'capability_denied', capability: 'skills.install', hint: 'request admin approval'}) — NOT silent fail. The list/catalog/info actions are unauthenticated (read-only). Reuse the in-process Go handlers via direct function call (NOT HTTP roundtrip — avoids loopback latency + double-auth). Live-test: probe_chat 3-turn: (1) 'Lista le skill installate' → tools_used=['skill'], action=list, response includes 'aura-runtime-safety'; (2) 'Mostrami il catalogo skills.sh' → action=catalog, ≥10 entries; (3) 'Installa frontend-design da anthropics/skills' → action=install, returns capability_denied (no SKILLS_ADMIN by default) OR success if admin token present.
acceptanceCriteria: internal/agent/tools/registry/skill.go (NEW ~180 LOC) defines SkillTool implementing Name='skill', Description (≤200 chars), Parameters with action enum + per-action args (source/skill_id for install, name for info/remove), Execute(ctx, args) dispatches on action
Action wiring uses in-process Go function calls to existing internal/skills/{catalog,admin,loader}.go — NO HTTP roundtrip to /api/skills/*

Admin gate: install + remove actions check ctx capabilities; if SKILLS_ADMIN missing, return JSON {error:'capability_denied', capability:'skills.install', hint:'...', schema:'denial'} so LLM can communicate the gate to user (visible failure, not silent error)

EVIDENCE from 2026-05-24 19:42 DB row: user 'Puoi installare skills?' → Aura 'non ho un comando specifico chiamato install_skill', then phantom-guard fired when Aura tried to fake-invoke. After this story ships, that exact prompt MUST trigger skill(action=list) or skill(action=catalog) — verify in live test 2. ADMIN GATE VISIBILITY: per feedback_no_regex_for_nlp, the denial schema MUST be structured JSON the LLM can reliably parse — NOT a free-text 'sorry, permission denied'. Schema: {error:'capability_denied', capability:'<cap>', hint:'<actionable>', schema:'denial'}. The LLM then communicates the gate to the user honestly (not pretends to succeed). NO scope creep: do NOT add skill creation/edit (those are file-tool territory if you want to author a skill manually). do NOT modify SKILLS_ADMIN gate semantics (existing behavior preserved). JUST surface the existing HTTP handlers as a tool with a clean denial schema.
